pin_title: 6 Christmas Gifts for Her Under £25 UK Shoppers Love
pin_title_alt: Cosy Christmas Gift Ideas That Feel Expensive
pin_hook: Thoughtful, highly rated and budget friendly
pin_description: Christmas gifts for her under £25 that UK shoppers rate highly: a fluffy fleece blanket, soy wax candle tin set, gold trinket dish, suede slipper boots, a preserved rose necklace and a fun mug set. Easy Christmas gift ideas for mum, sister or best friend. #ad #christmasgifts #giftsforher #ukchristmas #giftideas
intro: Still working through the Christmas list? These are the gifts for her that UK shoppers keep buying and rating highly year after year - cosy, pretty and all under £25.

products.name: BEDELITE Fluffy Fleece Blanket
products.headline: The blanket everyone fights over on movie night
products.why: Soft, generously sized and machine washable - a cosy gift that gets used all winter, not left in a drawer.

products.name: Dsclavacy Scented Candle Tin Set
products.headline: 12 travel tin candles, one thoughtful gift
products.why: A set of long-lasting soy wax candles in different scents, so there's something for every mood - an easy win for a gift that feels bigger than its price.

products.name: Gold Trinket Dish Jewellery Tray
products.headline: Pretty catch-all for rings and earrings
products.why: A small decorative dish for the bedside table or vanity - looks far more expensive than it is and suits almost any decor.

products.name: EverFoams Suede Bootie Slippers
products.headline: Memory foam comfort she'll live in
products.why: A genuinely loved slipper with a faux fur collar and memory foam sole - consistently one of the best-reviewed slippers on Amazon UK.

products.name: Preserved Rose with Necklace Gift Box
products.headline: A rose that lasts and a necklace that stays
products.why: A preserved rose paired with a simple pendant necklace, boxed and ready to give - a sentimental gift that needs no extra wrapping.

products.name: The Leonardo Collection His & Her Mug Set
products.headline: A fine china mug set with a bit of fun
products.why: Individually gift-boxed 'His Lordship' and 'Her Ladyship' mugs - a playful pairing that works as a couple's gift or a cheeky stocking filler.
